title: EastWest Dream Run 2026 Iloilo Review: Runrio's Series Finale
seo_title: EastWest Dream Run Iloilo 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: EastWest Dream Run 2026 Iloilo: September 20. Runrio-produced bank-branded race in the City of Love. Registration pending.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 in Iloilo City, this Runrio-produced EastWest Bank race is the Iloilo leg of the nationwide series. Registration pending.
verdict: The EastWest Dream Run Iloilo is the Visayas leg of the Runrio-produced, EastWest Bank-branded series. Iloilo City — the 'City of Love' with its heritage houses, the Iloilo River Esplanade, and la paz batchoy — is one of the Philippines' most charming race destinations. Runrio's gold-standard production ensures professional race-day operations. Registration isn't open yet. For runners wanting a bank-backed, professionally-produced race in one of the country's most liveable cities, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: Iloilo: City of Love
paragraphs: Iloilo is one of the Philippines' most charming cities — heritage houses, the river esplanade, and a food scene that rivals anywhere in the country. [1] Runrio's production + EastWest Bank branding = a professionally-produced race in a genuinely appealing destination.
